note: Small family-run RV/tent campground on US-24 at Lake George, wooded sites off the highway; near Eleven Mile and Spinney Mountain reservoirs. Directory listings (not the operator) describe full-hookup 30/50 amp sites, some pull-through. No website of its own; phone from its Google listing. --Claude

flags: Missing website: the operator has no website or booking page (Google listing has none; the stored Hipcamp listing was never published). Presence met only via Google Maps: 4.1 stars / 75 reviews, phone 719-748-8191.

No posted 2024+ rate from the operator; the price indicator is only the stored RV Life $$ tier. A low-quality web page claims $55 (30A) / $65 (50A) a night, unverifiable; if true it would fail the US$50 gate. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Denver 91 km); the family has not stayed here. A phone call is the only way to confirm.

Possible long-stay/character problem: the two newest Google reviews (about 2 months old) are 1-star ('the family's staying there were up drinking and partying all night', 'absolutely disgusting. You are not safe here'); an older review mentions paying a 'storage fee'. Nothing states monthly/residents, so long-stay tests not failed on evidence, but worth a human look.
